lessons_used: Reordering steps, estimated wait countdowns, pet tutorial screens, personality-driven headlines, path duration hints, and account sync safety hints improved performance.
Bypassing onboarding steps yielded mixed results (winning once, but hurting significantly in another test).
Major redesigns, companion benefit story copy, photo guidance copy, and account recovery safety hints significantly hurt performance.
Notifications, layout modifications, incentives, guide screens, permission checks, and most wait info or copy updates showed no clear effect.
Predictions generally overestimated gains across most tests, particularly for redesigns, guide screens, and copy changes.
Predictions underestimated performance for pet control tutorial screens, wait countdowns, personality-driven headlines, path duration hints, and account sync safety hints.

candidates.title: Existing account pet restore hint
candidates.change: Add a clear text hint under sign-in options prompting returning users to sign in with their original account to restore existing pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again, and account sync safety hints previously proved effective.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your previous account method to restore existing desktop pets and progress.

guard.reason: Valid sign-in hint addition inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Account sync safety hints previously proved effective and support mail directly highlights missing pet issues after sign-in.

candidates.title: Desktop pet generation audio progress cues
candidates.change: Add a visual timer component and enable estimated duration display on the waiting screen while pet generation processes.
candidates.why: Median time on home waiting step is 201s with a high mean (2336s), causing drop-off before generation completes.

guard.reason: Adding a next action component to the waiting screen makes the required waiting step skippable.

candidates.title: Pre-adoption pet naming screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet naming screen right after photo upload to let users name their companion before finalizing adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.3%; introducing personal naming early builds emotional investment before certificate signing.

new_pet_naming.headline: Name Your New Companion
new_pet_naming.body: Give your desktop companion a unique name before finalizing adoption.

guard.reason: Adding a new pet naming screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off (69.3%), and while new screens show modest gains (+2.5%), creating a new screen requires release effort.

candidates.title: Companion personality trait selector flow
candidates.change: Insert a trait choice sub-flow screen where users pick companion personality traits (e.g. Playful, Calm) to shape pet behavior.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion in the funnel (69.3%) and users report post-onboarding confusion about controlling and interacting with their pet.

new_trait_selection.headline: Choose Companion Personality
new_trait_selection.body: Select your pet's core personality trait to shape how it interacts on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a trait selection sub-flow inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 30.7% and support notes pet interaction confusion, but historical adoption new_flow tests yield modest +1.2% lift.

candidates.title: Reorder path choice before story screen
candidates.change: Move the companion path selection screen to appear immediately at launch before the story intro screen.
candidates.why: Path selection median time is 8s but mean is 514s; presenting interactive path selection immediately reduces initial drop-off.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Interactive adoption certificate checklist redesign
candidates.change: Redesign adoption certificate screen using a checklist layout paired with an adoption verification badge component.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.3%; structured interactive confirmation reinforces user commitment before pet generation.

adoption_certificate.headline: Finalize Adoption Details
adoption_certificate.body: Review companion details and check off adoption terms to confirm setup.

guard.reason: Redesign removes the required official stamp from the adoption certificate.

candidates.title: Path choice estimated time headline
candidates.change: Update headline on choose path screen to explicitly frame setup time expectations.
candidates.why: Path selection mean duration is high (514s); duration hints previously succeeded in setting quick expectations.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Companion Path (Takes Under 2 Minutes)

guard.reason: Setting headline copy with time estimate is allowed and does not create false urgency.

candidates.score_note: Path duration hints previously improved performance and set clear time expectations for high setup mean durations.

candidates.title: Desktop pet wake shortcut prompt on finish screen
candidates.change: Add a prominent keyboard shortcut badge and helper hint on the home intro screen detailing desktop pet toggle controls.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted confusion on how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding, and finish step conversion is 71.6%.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon or hide your pet on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding desktop shortcut info to home intro screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses post-onboarding confusion noted in 3 support tickets, though incentives and guide screens historically show mixed gains.

candidates.title: Background pet generation ready alert toggle
candidates.change: Enable background notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get notified when pet generation finishes while multitasking.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s because users switch windows during long generation times.

waiting.hint: We will notify you the instant your companion is ready on your desktop.

guard.reason: Enabling notification toggle on waiting screen is explicitly allowed under onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Helps address long wait times (2336s), but notifications previously showed only minor effect (+1.4%).

candidates.title: Upload photos stage layout update
candidates.change: Update upload photos screen to use stage layout with interactive photo picker and preview components.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong during photo creation.

guard.reason: Redesigning the photo upload layout while keeping photo selection functionality is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 30.7% and support has photo complaints, but layout updates and photo guidance changes historically showed no clear effect or hurt performance.

picked: Desktop pet wake shortcut prompt on finish screen
Background pet generation ready alert toggle

decisions.title: Desktop pet wake shortcut prompt on finish screen
Background pet generation ready alert toggle

lessons_next: Reordering steps, wait countdowns, tutorial screens, personality headlines, path duration hints, account sync hints, and initial flow bypasses improved performance.
Flow bypasses yielded mixed results, whereas major redesigns, trait selector flows, photo guidance, benefits copy, path time headlines, and account recovery hints significantly hurt performance.
Notifications, layout modifications, incentives, permission checks, and most remaining copy or hint updates showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains overall, particularly for major redesigns, trait selector flows, guide screens, and copy changes.
Predictions underestimated gains for pet control tutorial screens, wait countdowns, personality headlines, path duration hints, and account sync safety hints.
